pyqs.independentSolution: Term n=(sum k³ from 1 to n)/(1+3+...+(2n−1))=[n(n+1)/2]²/n²=(n+1)²/4. Sum n=1..8=(sum j² j=1..9−1)/4=(285−1)/4=71. Direct rational enumeration also gives71.
Term n=(sum k² k=1..n)/n=(n+1)(2n+1)/6=(2n²+3n+1)/6. For n=1..10 sums squares385, integers55, ones10 give (770+165+10)/6=315/2. Direct rational enumeration independently agrees.

targetQuestionText: Find the sum of the first eight terms of 1³/1 + (1³ + 2³)/(1 + 3) + (1³ + 2³ + 3³)/(1 + 3 + 5) + ⋯.
